commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Substitution. Elye Wahi (Marseille) on for Neal Maupay.
90+2' Deiver Machado (Lens) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post.
90+1' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 3 Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) scores from the resulting free kick with a bullet of a strike that goes into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper couldn't react fast enough.
88' Marseille win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
86' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lens due to a foul in the build-up play.
86' Wait! Referee Eric Wattellier has indicated he is going to review the Lens goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.

85' Goal! Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot inside the right post. Angelo Fulgini assisted in the goal. 2:2.
84' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
83' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Kevin Danso (Lens) for his blatant foul.
81' Mason Greenwood will be replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Marseille).
80' 1 - 2 Goal! Deiver Machado (Lens) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:2.
79' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
79' Lens concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Marseille have a free kick.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Bilal Nadir (Marseille) coming on for Valentin Rongier.
77' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Angelo Fulgini (Lens) replacing Hamzat Ojediran.
77' Luis Henrique (Marseille) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
74' Deiver Machado (Lens) has tested the patience of referee Eric Wattellier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Andy Diouf (Lens) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
71' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
69' Today's match ends for Malang Sarr who will be replaced by Anass Zaroury (Lens).

69' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Geronimo Rulli shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
68' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
68' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Lens get a corner.
67' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
65' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
64' Lens play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
63' 4:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
61' Lens showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
58' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Florian Sotoca will be replaced by Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens).
58' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adrien Thomasson as he is replaced by Andy Diouf (Lens).
58' Will Still has decided to substitute David Pereira da Costa and he is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens).
57' 0 - 2 GOAL! Luis Henrique (Marseille) runs onto a pass from Neal Maupay after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 0:2.
56' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
53' Ball possession – 45:55.
49' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Valentin Rongier (Marseille) was set free in the area by Neal Maupay and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
41' Great touch by M'Bala Nzola (Lens) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
40' Neal Maupay (Marseille) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Marseille.
37' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) for his blatant foul.
35' Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
34' 6:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
31' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

30' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Lens force their opponents to concede a corner.
30' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) is caught offside!
27' The cross fools the defence and leaves Facundo Medina (Lens) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
26' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Lens force a corner. They send men into the box.
24' Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.

22' Florian Sotoca (Lens) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Geronimo Rulli sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Valentin Rongier (Marseille) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
15' The free kick from long range, taken by Lens, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
12' A pass by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Rough tackle by Hamzat Ojediran (Lens). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
11' Lens are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.

9' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
8' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

7' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Geronimo Rulli guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.
5' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
3' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
3' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lens will kick the game off.
Eric Wattellier is the one to supervise the game today.
